user.title: Smart Water hub
user.description: v0.2 plans and records. It never opens a valve. Elevation is used for Penman-Monteith air pressure. Home Assistant often stores 0; the central Texas site in the design notes is about 219 m. Leave latitude and longitude empty to use Home Assistant's location.

behavior.title: How the hub behaves
behavior.description: Dry-run is off by default. This version still will not water: there is no executor. The schedule preset only decides which days and hours a plan may use. Waco presets follow the city year-round rules (odd or even address, no Friday, no watering 10:00–19:00).

data.plan_hour: Hour to commit the daily balance and notify
data.forecast_skip_mm: Skip when forecast rain is at least

data_description.notify_target: Example: mobile_app_phone, or notify.mobile_app_phone. Empty sends nothing.
data_description.forecast_skip_mm: Leave empty to disable. A 0.25 inch rule is not assumed.
data_description.earliest_hour: Local hour on the morning of the run. Empty means the plan only has to finish by sunrise.
data_description.round_minutes: On keeps every cycle a whole minute. Off keeps tenths of a minute.
data_description.schedule_preset: None uses every day. Waco presets ignore the custom days and hours below. Custom uses the weekdays and blackout you set.
data_description.allowed_weekdays: Used only with the custom preset. Leave empty to allow every day.
data_description.blackout_start_hour: First hour when watering is not allowed, local time. Used by None and Custom. Waco always uses 10.
data_description.blackout_end_hour: First hour when watering is allowed again. Used by None and Custom. Waco always uses 19.
data_description.drip_ignores_schedule: Buried drip may skip the weekday check. The blackout still applies. Off by default.

sensors.title: Optional weather sensors
sensors.description: Entity sensors are preferred. The weather entity is the fallback. A Tempest solar radiation sensor in W/m² is integrated through the day into MJ/m². A daily MJ/m² sensor is used as-is. UV index is only a fallback and is not an FAO measurement. Pressure, when set, should be station pressure.

data_description.uv_sensor: Used only when solar radiation is empty. About 100 W/m² per UV index, not an FAO factor.
data_description.rain_amount_sensor: Preferred over the weather forecast. Daily total matches Tempest rain today.
data_description.rain_kind: Daily total replaces the day's rain. Cumulative adds increases and ignores the first sample. Rate is mm/h, integrated between updates.

error.latitude_pair: Set both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.

init.title: Smart Water options
init.description: Dry-run defaults off. Turning it on only marks the plan as not-for-execution. v0.2 still does not water.

data.plan_hour: Hour to commit the daily balance and notify
data.forecast_skip_mm: Skip when forecast rain is at least

data_description.notify_target: Example: mobile_app_phone, or notify.mobile_app_phone. Empty sends nothing.
data_description.schedule_preset: None uses every day. Waco presets ignore the custom days and hours. Custom uses the weekdays and blackout you set.
data_description.allowed_weekdays: Used only with the custom preset.
data_description.drip_ignores_schedule: Weekday check only. The blackout still applies.

user.title: Zone
user.description: Plant and soil set the starting crop coefficient, depletion fraction, root depth, and intake rate. You can edit the numbers on the next step. Sprinkler type changes the default soak: drip and bubbler do not soak unless you set one.

hydraulics.title: Watering hardware
hydraulics.description: Enter a precipitation rate, or both flow and area. The rate you type is used when both are filled in. Efficiency defaults to 1 so no unverified distribution uniformity is assumed. The on/off entity is stored for a later version and is not turned on. Moisture and flow are optional.

data_description.priority: Lower numbers run first when two zones are both ready.
data_description.max_cycle_min: Replaces the NRCS intake calculation. Use this after a pooling test.
data_description.efficiency: 1.0 applies the net deficit. Set a measured distribution uniformity below 1 if you have one.
data_description.valve_entity: Switch, valve, or input boolean. Stored only. v0.2 does not call it.
data_description.moisture_mode: Off ignores the sensor. Correct blends it into the bucket once per day. Override replaces the bucket on every update.
data_description.moisture_kind: Relative is percent of available water (0–100, or a 0–1 fraction). Volumetric needs field capacity.
data_description.flow_sensor: Any sensor that reports a volume total or a flow rate. Used to flag low flow and leaks. Nothing is closed.
data_description.flow_low_ratio: Delivered ÷ expected below this, after the run window, is low flow. Default 0.5.
data_description.flow_leak_ratio: Delivered ÷ expected above this is a leak. Default 1.5. Unscheduled delivery of at least 1 gallon is also a leak.

error.name_exists: A zone with this name already exists.
error.precipitation_rate: Enter a precipitation rate, or both flow and area.

options.auto: Auto (still blocked in v0.2, and while dry-run is on)

options.correct: Correct the bucket once a day
options.override: Override the bucket on every update

calculate_plan.name: Calculate plan
calculate_plan.description: Build tonight's plan. Does not open a valve.

reset_bucket.name: Reset bucket
reset_bucket.description: Set a zone's deficit to zero. Does not open a valve.

set_bucket.name: Set bucket
set_bucket.description: Set a zone's deficit in millimeters or inches. Does not open a valve.

mark_watered.name: Mark watered
mark_watered.description: Credit net irrigation that already happened. Does not open a valve.

skip_zone.name: Skip zone
skip_zone.description: Leave a zone out of the plan through a date.

pause_zone.name: Pause zone
pause_zone.description: Skip a zone for a number of days. Zero clears the pause. Does not open a valve.

set_adjustment.name: Set adjustment
set_adjustment.description: Scale a zone's planned depth. 100 is unchanged. Does not open a valve.

run_now.name: Run now
run_now.description: Log the planned run. Does not call the zone's on/off entity.
